desc: Implement complete solution with raw stdin parsing, N<3 early exit, and small-N sparse pair enumeration.
Add NumPy FFT primary path for large N: indicator array, power-of-two FFT length, rounded convolution, sum adjusted even coefficients.
Add pure-Python fallback: endpoint-parity base-2^20 big-integer convolution, packed bytearray construction, product byte extraction, self-pair correction.
Test samples and edge cases (N<3, small N with large max_val, all even/odd, dense set) and verify no carries/rounding issues.
